rising.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
rising.title_zh: LongZero：从零数据增强LLM长上下文推理
rising.summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）是增强大语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理的有效方法，但需要长、多样、有挑战且可验证的训练数据。此类数据的人工标注昂贵，自然出现的数据过于稀缺，无法支撑RL，而现有合成方法依赖外部语料或更强的教师模型，随着被训练模型变强，这些越来越难以获得。近期，从零数据RL——模型从自己提出的任务中学习——已取得优异性能，但现有方法针对短上下文任务。因此，我们提出$\textbf{LongZero}$，一种让LLM在无任何外部数据的情况下提升自身长上下文推理的方法。LongZero不是基于现有文档写问题和答案，而是先让模型以紧凑结构化形式合成问题、答案及其支持证据，然后单独将证据扩展为长多文档上下文。LongZero将这些自写多跳推理任务与自写多轮检索任务结合，并用GRPO训练模型。我们在两个LLM上跨五个长上下文推理基准评估LongZero，并与基于外部语料合成数据的RL比较。实验结果表明

extra.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.

rising.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
rising.title_zh: 在关键处更深入思考：面向序列推荐的物品级自适应递归
rising.summary_zh: 现有序列推荐器通常为用户交互历史中的每个物品分配固定计算预算，而不论该物品对最终预测的贡献。我们通过两项诊断发现挑战这一事实上的设计。（1）非均匀计算需求：同一序列内的物品所需计算量差异巨大。大多数在浅层处理后收敛，而关键少数仅在全深度时稳定。（2）固定分配次优：在可获知目标物品的oracle条件下，非均匀深度分配始终优于固定分配，表明现有均匀计算既在已收敛物品上浪费容量，又牺牲整体推荐质量。这些观察促使从固定深度计算转向物品级自适应推理。为此，我们提出LoopRec。LoopRec递归应用单个权重共享块，并在每个递归边界引入轻量门控，对每个物品独立做出二元退出或继续决策。表示已充分成熟的物品提前退出，而需要更深推理的物品继续后续递归。该设计将固定全局深度转化为学习的逐物品属性，无需辅助深度标签，且易于适配多种骨干架构。在公开基准上对四个骨干系列的广泛实验表明，LoopRec始终优于匹配的

extra.description: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.

extra.description: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.

dropped.title_zh: HRD：人类生殖与发育的综合多组学资源
dropped.summary_zh: 摘要 人类生殖与发育是一个由遗传、分子和环境因素塑造的连续过程。然而，相关数据仍分散在公共存储库和文献中，限制了系统整合、分析和再利用。我们开发了人类生殖与发育数据库（HRD；http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/），这是一个综合多组学资源，组织与多个生殖、妊娠和发育背景相关的公开可用数据。HRD 1.0版包含814条组学记录，包括432条批量转录组、144条单细胞或单核转录组、156条表观基因组、52条代谢组和30条蛋白质组记录，以及702条临床试验记录、293条暴露-结局关联和779个带有 curated 表型关联的先导SNP。通过协调关键元数据并应用数据类型特定的分析工作流，HRD将组学数据、遗传关联、暴露-结局证据和临床试验数据纳入一个共同框架，以探索生殖和发育多个阶段的数据。该网站支持关键词搜索、组合筛选、基于类别的浏览、统计摘要和数据下载，并提供差异分析、功能富集

extra.description: Abstract Human reproduction and development span a continuum shaped by genetic, molecular, and environmental factors. However, relevant data remain dispersed across public repositories and the literature, limiting systematic integration, analysis, and reuse. We developed the Human Reproduction and Development Database (HRD; http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/), an integrated multi-omics resource that organizes publicly available data relevant to multiple reproductive, pregnancy, and developmental contexts. HRD version 1.0 contains 814 omics records, including 432 bulk transcriptomic, 144 single-cell or single-nucleus transcriptomic, 156 epigenomic, 52 metabolomic, and 30 proteomic records, together with 702 clinical trial records, 293 exposure-outcome associations, and 779 lead SNPs with curated phenotype associations. extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

longest_on_board.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
longest_on_board.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。
